Chi cerchiamo Hai esperienza nel settore automotive come Brand Manager, responsabile vendite o venditore senior con coordinamento di una squadra. Hai solide capacità commerciali e di negoziazione. Decidi partendo dai numeri e usi con sicurezza CRM, reportistica ed Excel. Guidi le persone con autorevolezza ed esempio, più che con la gerarchia. Sono un plus la conoscenza della Brianza, dei processi delle Case Madri e dei prodotti finanziari e assicurativi. Cosa offriamo Un ruolo di responsabilità con visibilità diretta sui risultati e sulle scelte commerciali della sede. RAL tra 35.000 e 40.000 euro, commisurata all'esperienza, più un piano incentivante su risultati personali e di squadra. Brand storici e brand in forte crescita nella stessa sede: un contesto in cui costruire, non solo gestire. La solidità di un gruppo nazionale come Intergea e le opportunità di crescita che ne derivano. Orario di lavoro: 40 ore settimanali, dal lunedì al sabato. Sede di lavoro: Seregno (MB). Segnala offerta di lavoro Candidati ora Senior Manager Sales, Italy Olympus Italia Srl (OIT) | Funzione Tipo di impiego: Luogo Segrate Numero Del Lavoro 80014651-22102026 Contatti Hannah Nash Sito Web https://www.olympus.it With about 175 employees, Olympus Italia SrL, based in Segrate, near Milan, is responsible for the distribution on the Italian territory of Olympus products dedicated to the healthcare and research market, such as: medical systems products (rigid and flexible endoscopes, microscopy) and industrial products (endoscopy, microscopy, high speed cameras and security technology). Le tue responsabilità For more than 100 years, our mission has been to make people's lives healthier and safer. We achieve this through innovation. As pioneers in technology, we design and deliver solutions across our Medical and Scientific divisions that make a positive contribution to society. Our products are essential for advancing scientific research and helping healthcare professionals diagnose, treat and prevent diseases. In the medical field, we develop and manufacture state-of-the-art technologies for diagnosis and therapy, ranging from endoscopes to electrosurgical devices. We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager – GI-ET/RESP to join our organization in Italy, based in Milan. Reporting directly to the Cluster Business Unit Leader GI-ET/RESP, the successful candidate will be responsible for leading commercial activities across Italy, coordinating the direct team of Territory Managers and the network of sales agencies operating nationwide. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on commercial management, with overall responsibility for driving sales performance and business growth in Italy, strengthening customer relationships and ensuring the achievement of commercial objectives, in close collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Sales Strategy & Business Development: Define and implement the national sales strategy, identify business growth opportunities and translate strategic priorities into clear commercial action plans to achieve sales and business objectives. Sales Team Leadership: Lead, coordinate and develop the direct team of Territory Managers, fostering collaboration, accountability and a strong results-oriented mindset. Agency Management: Coordinate and support sales agencies operating across Italy, ensuring alignment with the company's commercial strategy and business objectives. Budget & Performance Management: Take full ownership of sales performance, budget achievement and commercial execution across ET (GI & Respiratory) in Italy, ensuring effective forecasting, KPI management and timely corrective actions. Customer Relationship Management: Develop and strengthen relationships with strategic customers and key stakeholders, including healthcare decision-makers and scientific associations. Tender & Negotiation Management: Oversee public tender processes and commercial negotiations, coordinating the Sales Force and Back Office in collaboration with the Marketing Team. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Marketing, Technical Service and other internal stakeholders to translate business strategy into effective commercial initiatives, product launches and field execution, while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. Events & Scientific Engagement: Coordinate the organization and management of congresses, training courses and other events across the country. Le tue qualifiche University degree preferred, ideally in business, economics, life sciences or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Extensive experience in sales and sales management roles within the medical device or MedTech industry. In-depth knowledge of the Italian healthcare market and public administration. Proven experience in public tender management and commercial negotiations. Proficiency in written and spoken English. Willingness to travel nationwide according to business needs. Le tue competenze Strong leadership and people management skills, with experience coordinating sales teams and indirect sales networks. Strong business acumen and results orientation, with the ability to translate strategy into actionable plans. Excellent negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills. Strong analytical skills and experience managing budgets, KPIs and commercial performance. Excellent organizational skills, flexibility and the ability to manage complex situations and work under pressure. I tuoi vantaggi Joining Olympus means contributing to a mission that puts people's health at the center, while working in an international, innovative and collaborative environment. We are committed to supporting our employees' professional development, wellbeing and work-life balance. Compensation Package: Employment under the Italian Commerce Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL Commercio), with an annual gross salary .paid over 14 months instalments, comprising a fixed component and a variable component. The final compensation package will be determined based on the candidate's professional experience, skills and level of autonomy, ensuring alignment with the role and internal pay equity. Company Car: A company car for both business and private use, provided as part of the benefits package for employees in business and field-based roles. Social Benefits: Access to company initiatives and benefits designed to support employee wellbeing and contribute to a positive working environment. Career Growth & Development: Opportunities for professional growth within the company, supported by mentoring programmes, personalized career development plans and regular performance reviews. Birthday Leave: One additional paid day off on your birthday, giving you the opportunity to celebrate your special day with your loved ones. Learning & Development: Access to training courses, workshops, e-learning platforms and opportunities to attend industry conferences and events, supporting continuous professional and personal development. Corporate Volunteering: Opportunities to participate in corporate volunteering initiatives and contribute to social and environmental responsibility projects, making a positive impact on the community. Psychological Support: Access to a professional and confidential psychological support service, offering guidance and assistance during challenging personal or professional situations and promoting emotional wellbeing and work-life balance. At Olympus, we believe in the value of people, collaboration and innovation to improve patients' lives. If you are ready to leverage your commercial expertise and leadership skills in a meaningful, high-impact industry, we look forward to hearing from you! Full-Cycle Talent Partner | APAC EU | Talent Strategy & Advisory | Scaling Teams Across Multiple Markets Kō wai mātou? Who are we? Zespri is more than simply the world's single-largest marketer of kiwifruit. We like to think of ourselves as fruit on a mission and as rebels with a cause: to help people, communities and the environment around the world thrive through the goodness of kiwifruit. We are proudly the world's largest marketer of kiwifruit, selling kiwifruit in more than 50 countries. We work with around 2,800 New Zealand and 1,500 international growers and post-harvest companies to source the best-quality Zespri Kiwifruit which we supply through our distribution partners to wholesale and retail customers. We are one of New Zealand's best-known international brands, dedicated to creating sustainable long-term value for growers. He aha te mahi? What's the role? Based in Milan, the Key Account Manager is a part of the IT Med team, who will drive Zespri’s sales and brand development across the region, with a primary focus on Italy. You’ll build strong relationships with key retail accounts and execute retail strategies that grow the kiwifruit category and strengthen Zespri’s in-store presence. Please take note that this is a 12 months fixed term opportunity. Accountabilities Drive sustainable business growth Support Zespri’s growth strategy and drive its execution across IT Med. Build long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Grow B2B customers through Joint Business Planning (JBP). Grow volume, value and brand visibility Develop and execute POS, trade marketing and shopper activation plans across channels. Partner with retailers to deliver effective sales promotions and omnichannel shopper activations. Create targeted trade and sales materials. Lead category management, including range and merchandising recommendations that meet shopper needs and grow the kiwifruit category. Work with the local KAM team to manage Customer Funds, measure ROI and optimise channel and shopper investments. Partner with the Market Manager IT Med to respond to changing customer, competitor, shopper and supply conditions. Support forecasting, stock control and day-to-day sales operations. Analyse performance and identify opportunities to close gaps and accelerate growth. Apply best practices from within Zespri and other industries to strengthen channel development. Be Zespri’s eyes and ears in the market Monitor local market developments and recommend proactive and reactive actions. Ensure retailer and distributor agreements are followed through. Track kiwifruit and wider fruit-market pricing and key category measures. Gather insights to support effective category management. Contribute to the wider team Collaborate proactively across European and global teams, contributing insights that help shape Zespri’s future strategic direction. Ko wai koe? Who are you? You’ll bring 3–5+ years of sales and trade marketing experience, ideally from fresh produce or FMCG, together with a strong understanding of the Italian retail market. You’ll also have: A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics or a related discipline. Strong analytical skills and confidence turning data and insights into commercial decisions. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills. Native-level Italian and fluency in English. A proactive, agile and results-driven approach. Strong problem-solving, communication and relationship-building skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams. Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility to travel throughout the IT Med region. He aha e tika ai a Zespri? Why Zespri? Our people are what makes our culture so irresistible and uniquely Zespri. We are a passionate and mighty team of 850+ employees in 23 different locations globally. Working at Zespri is an opportunity to join a fast-paced, culture-driven environment unlike any other. We want people who share our values of making it happen, creating real connections, and leaving a legacy. Join us in shaping our future and be part of a truly unique organisation. Competitive base salary of between EUR54,000 and EUR59,700. Please note that individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, performance and work location. FlexWELL flexible work ethos; WFH & the office. Additional paid annual leave day per year (Zespri Day). Global Life and Permanent Disability Insurance. Group Medical Insurance benefits Tono mai inaianei! Apply Now! Applications close 2 December 2026 At Zespri, we understand the importance of diverse perspectives and experiences, and a fair hiring process is the first step to getting there. We want to attract a diverse range of people and encourage everyone from all backgrounds and walks of life to apply. Please let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments to take part in the recruitment and selection process by reaching out to our Talent Acquisition team via email at careers@zespri.com. Agency Zespri will not accept applications or contact from any temporary staffing agency, placement service or professional recruiter for this vacancy (“Agency”). Where Zespri requires the support of an agency to fulfil a vacancy, we will proactively seek this support from our network of Agencies. We respectfully ask that you do not contact Zespri or any of its affiliates/employees regarding vacancies, and reserve the right not to reply. Zespri will not be responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions or other payments related to such unsolicited resumes. Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da DuPont Sara García Kinane Sara García Kinane At DuPont, our purpose is to empower the world with essential innovations to thrive. We work on things that matter. Whether it’s providing clean water to more than a billion people on the planet, producing materials that are essential in everyday technology devices from smartphones to electric vehicles, or protecting workers around the world. Discover the many reasons the world’s most talented people are choosing to work at DuPont. Why Join Us | DuPont Careers You are a team player, who has an agile mindset and thinks outside the box? This opportunity is perfect for you! - join the new DuPont Water “Projects” team now. DuPont Water Solutions (DWS) is a $1.4 Bn water technology leader, focused on solving global challenges in water purification, conservation and reuse. DWS serves its thousands of customers in diverse markets using multiple technologies from its portfolio across major geographies of the world. We offer excellent development opportunities, advanced training possibilities, attractive compensation & benefits and flexible working conditions. Together, we’re turning possibilities into real world answers that help humanity prosper! Come realize how you can make an impact, act like an owner and partner with customers in our journey. Water Solutions is seeking a Sales- and Project Manager - Internal Sales, for the DuPont Water business in EMEA to grow the business within the region. The position is part of the “projects” group in the commercial organization of DuPont Water Solutions. This committed role will provide a challenging mixture of commercial and technical activities to accelerate project growth with all integrated product lines. The individual responsible for this role will reside in Milano (Italy), Greifenberg (Germany), Dubai (UAE) or Tarragona (Spain). The purpose and scope of the job or role: why it exists Provide commercial and basic technical support for project opportunities from qualification to execution through whole project lifecycle. Lead the project execution of large projects including coordination with internal functions and customers. Support large and complex projects with document control, contract management and structured project execution. Prepare integrated UF, MBR and RO proposals, quotations and supporting documentation. Act as the interface between customers, commercial teams, and internal functions. Contribute to customer satisfaction, profitable growth and delivery of agreed project commitments. What You'll Do Support contract review and negotiation, including scope, milestones, payment terms, guarantees, warranties, liabilities and change management. Coordinate document control, submittals, quality documentation and customer approval processes for large and complex projects. Prepare proposals, tender documents and technical and commercial clarifications. Translate contractual obligations into clear actions, deliverables, responsibilities and project plans. Lead project kick-off and execution, coordinating Customer Service, Engineering, Technical, Quality, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Legal and field-service resources. Track scope, schedule, risks, changes, invoicing, payments and customer commitments through project close-out. Support sales teams with opportunity development, customer requirements, forecasts and reporting. Provide product guidance and coordinate inputs from Technical Specialists and other internal functions. Manage direct quotations for customers, spare parts and pilot plants in alignment with the responsible sales teams. Support order clarification, after-sales activities and customer communication throughout the project lifecycle. Critical Success Factors Strong customer and sales-support orientation with solid commercial and technical understanding. Experience preparing proposals, quotations and tender documentation for water-treatment projects. Ability to manage multiple opportunities while providing structured support to large projects. Knowledge of complex contracts, including review, negotiation, risk assessment and execution. Document-control, coordination and project-management capabilities. Ability to work across functions and regions and communicate clearly with customers and internal stakeholders. Structured working style, sound judgment, proactive problem solving and ability to perform under pressure. What You Need To Succeed Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management or an equivalent qualification. Relevant experience in Sales, Technical Sales, Technical Service, Contract Management or Project Management in water treatment or a comparable project business. Commercial and basic technical knowledge of UF, MBR and RO technologies. Experience with large international projects, project documentation and complex contracts is beneficial. Understanding of project economics, contracting, payment terms, guarantees, logistics and international trade. Proficiency in Microsoft Office; Salesforce, CPQ, SAP and project-planning tools are beneficial. Fluent English; additional languages are beneficial. At DuPont, we have an unbridled commitment to deliver essential innovations that enrich people’s lives, enable sustainable development, and foster human potential for generations to come. Innovations developed from highly engineered products and naturally sourced ingredients to shape industries and everyday life. From smarter homes to more efficient cars, from beer ways of digitally connecting to new tools that enable active and healthy lifestyles…in all these areas and many more, we’re working with customers to transform their ideas into real world answers that help humanity thrive. Diesen Job melden VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional Regional Process Owner Manager to join our team based in Stabio, Switzerland, on a permanent basis. Let’s talk about the role! The Regional Process Owner (RPO) is accountable for the design, governance and continuous improvement of the Engage-to-Cash (E2C) process across EMEA, from customer engagement and order capture through fulfilment and cash collection. The RPO ensures the process is executed consistently against agreed standards, while evolving it to meet changing customer expectations, market dynamics and fashion industry requirements. The role drives process harmonization, operational excellence and digital enablement , acting as a trusted partner to cross-functional teams and senior leadership. The RPO is a key influencer in shaping how the business delivers customer value efficiently, compliantly and at scale. Acting as the voice of the customer within E2C, the RPO reviews existing processes against customer feedback and business needs, balancing customer expectations with internal capabilities to deliver a seamless and responsive experience. Primary Accountabilities: PROCESS DESIGN AND STANDARDIZATION Drive the consistent implementation of E2C processes and services across EMEA brands, markets, channels and functions, in line with the agreed North Star process design. Maintain process integrity, promote leading practices and identify opportunities to simplify and harmonize ways of working. Document regional processes, controls, standards and procedures to support consistency, auditability and adoption. GOVERNANCE AND ISSUE RESOLUTION Lead regional E2C governance forums and act as the primary point of contact for systemic process issues. Lead root cause analysis for recurring problems and coordinate sustainable corrective actions through established governance forums. Monitor process risks, dependencies and decisions, escalating material issues to the appropriate process and functional leaders. CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT AND PERFORMANCE Identify and prioritize improvement opportunities using process data, customer and business feedback, risk, cost and benefit analysis. Lead quick wins and improvement initiatives from definition through implementation, tracking adoption and benefits realization. Define and monitor key E2C performance indicators (e.g. order accuracy, on-time-in-full, first-time-right, cycle time) and use the insights to improve process quality, service and efficiency. TECHNOLOGY AND INNOVATION Partner with Digital Technology and Business Intelligence to evolve the systems, tools and reporting that support E2C, including SAP, B2B platforms, Mobimedia, PKMS and dashboards. Translate process needs into clear business requirements and contribute to the regional E2C technology roadmap. Promote appropriate use of automation, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities to improve accuracy, throughput and customer experience. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION AND CHANGE Partner with Sales, Customer Operations, Distribution and Logistics, Finance, Planning, Digital Technology and EMEA brand teams to ensure end-to-end alignment. Influence stakeholders across functions and countries, constructively challenging legacy practices where they limit E2C outcomes. Act as an E2C subject matter expert and change agent, supporting communications, training and adoption of new processes and tools. COMPLIANCE AND RISK MANAGEMENT Ensure regional E2C processes reflect applicable internal policies, controls and relevant local or regional requirements. Coordinate required local process accommodations without compromising overall process integrity and standardization. Proactively address control gaps, compliance risks and audit findings in partnership with the relevant functions. Skills for Success and Key Competencies: University degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or a related field. 3+ years of experience in Order-to-Cash / Engage-to-Cash, customer operations, commercial services or process excellence, ideally in a multinational, multi-brand environment (fashion, apparel, footwear or consumer goods preferred). La missione Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in contesti tecnici , preferibilmente nella meccanica, micromeccanica o meccanica di precisione, capace di coniugare competenza tecnica, visione commerciale e attenzione alla qualità del servizio. La risorsa selezionata garantirà una gestione efficace e puntuale del processo commerciale, dalla richiesta iniziale del cliente fino all’evasione dell’ordine, assicurando precisione operativa, affidabilità e qualità nella relazione con interlocutori internazionali. Le responsabilità Gestire le anagrafiche clienti e l’intero ciclo dell’ordine, dall’inserimento al monitoraggio fino alla consegna. Analizzare le richieste dei clienti e interpretare il disegno tecnico, verificando la coerenza delle specifiche. Predisporre offerte commerciali, valutando con attenzione le caratteristiche tecniche dei prodotti e le esigenze del cliente. Verificare la disponibilità dei prodotti, monitorare l’avanzamento degli ordini e coordinare le informazioni relative alle consegne. Gestire la corrispondenza commerciale e mantenere aggiornati i clienti sullo stato delle forniture. Verificare e predisporre, ove necessario, la documentazione di trasporto, origine della merce e import-export. Gestire reclami, resi e note di credito, contribuendo alla risoluzione tempestiva delle problematiche. Collaborare con le diverse funzioni aziendali per ottimizzare i processi e migliorare continuamente il livello di servizio. Coordinare le attività di un piccolo team, favorendo collaborazione, organizzazione ed efficacia operativa. Monitorare la qualità del servizio e individuare opportunità di miglioramento. Il profilo ideale Formazione superiore in ambito tecnico, economico, commerciale o linguistico . Potete lavorare da casa, ufficio o direttamente dai clienti in Svizzera, Italia o in qualsiasi altro Paese che parli una delle sei lingue disponibili. Chi cerchiamo Stiamo cercando rappresentanti indipendenti, agenti plurimandatari oppure venditori con ditte individuali che abbiano voglia di aggiungere al proprio portafoglio di prodotti e servizi, una tecnologia molto valida in ambito IA applicata alla gestione automatica delle telefonate in entrata. Non parliamo di contact center cosiddetto "outbound" ovvero "chiamate in uscita", bensì un sistema per aiutare gli imprenditori, soprattutto piccoli, a gestire le chiamate in entrata. Studi medici, dentisti, specialisti sanitari Singoli professionisti in ambito salute, massaggiatori, terapisti, fisioterapisti, naturopati Garage, riparatori, carrozzieri Alberghi, BnB, affittacamere Ristoranti, pizzerie anche d'asporto Parrucchieri e centri estetici Avvocati e commercialisti / fiduciari Centri sportivi, campi da gioco, palestre Veterinari Agenti immobiliari Consulenti assicurativi e finanziari Questo è solo un esempio delle possibili verticalizzazioni, ma in realtà il servizio può essere utilizzato da chiunque. Qual è il servizio Il servizio di cui parliamo è YUNES AI, è il marchio di un'azienda svizzera Swissvoip SA che opera in qualsiasi mercato in 6 lingue: italiano, inglese, francese, tedesco, spagnolo e russo. Volete approfondire? Qui il link di riferimento. https://ai.yunes.ch/brochure.html?ref=B69YUG&lang=it Potete anche registrarvi gratuitamente e provare il servizio. In pratica Yunes AI risponde alle telefonate dei tuoi clienti 24 ore su 24, con una voce naturale e nella loro lingua, e fissa gli appuntamenti direttamente nella tua agenda — o, se sei un ristoratore, gestisce tavoli, coperti e ordini da asporto in modo automatico. Risponde anche ai messaggi del tuo WhatsApp Business. La retribuzione L'agente riceve, su base mensile, il 75% del fatturato generato dal cliente per il primo anno. Negli anni successivi riceve il 10% del fatturato. Salvo diversi accordi da valutare caso per caso. Quindi un abbonamento enterprise su base mensile di 299,99 CHF dà diritto all'agente a 56,25 CHF mensili per i primi 12 mesi e 22.50 CHF dal 13* mese in poi finché il cliente è attivo. Se il cliente cambia pacchetto, le provvigioni vengono adeguate a partire dal mese della variazione. Il pagamento Le provvigioni maturate sono visibili sul portale di back office e vengono liquidate mensilmente o trimestralmente a scelta dell'agente dietro presentazione di idonea fattura. Contratto Il contratto è quello di agente o procacciatore d'affari indipendente. È escluso il rapporto dipendente, a meno che non si raggiunga uno storico consolidato per almeno 12 mesi di lavoro. In tal caso è possibile discutere un'assunzione a condizioni da determinarsi. Come candidarsi? Du verbindest technisches Verständnis mit einem Gespür für geschäftliche Anforderungen und bringst Business, Finance und IT zusammen. Mit dir verbinden wir Preislogiken, Vertragskonditionen, Nutzungs- und Ereignisdaten sowie Rating, Charging und Fakturierung zu einer skalierbaren End-to-End-Lösung. Das kannst du bewirken. Du entwickelst die technische Produktvision, die Roadmap und das Backlog für Pricing und Billing gemeinsam mit Business Ownern, Business Engineering, Finance, Architektur und Umsetzungsteams. Dabei führst du die technische Umsetzung von Standard- und Vertragspreisen, Preisregeln, Rabatten, Zuschlägen, Staffeln und kundenspezifischen Konditionen bis zur abrechenbaren Position und Rechnung. Du stellst die eindeutige Referenz zwischen Product Offering, Vereinbarung, Preislogik, Nutzung beziehungsweise Event sowie Rating, Charging und Billing sicher. Zudem koordinierst du Integrationen zu Produkt- und Vertragsmanagement, Leistungsdaten, SAP- beziehungsweise Billing-Komponenten, Analytics, Support und Kundenkanälen. Du priorisierst Features und Enabler, steuerst Lieferteams und Anbieter und sicherst Betriebsfähigkeit, Nachvollziehbarkeit, Auditierbarkeit, Performance und Fehlerbehandlung. Darüber hinaus validierst du den End-to-End-Billingflow anhand von Referenzprodukten und -verträgen und leitest daraus die schrittweise Industrialisierung ab. Das bringst du mit. Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Technical Product Owner, IT Product Manager oder Solution Lead im Umfeld Pricing, Billing, Order-to-Cash oder Revenue Management. Zudem bringst du Kenntnisse in Preisfindung, Rating, Charging, Discounting, Fakturierung und den dafür benötigten Daten- und Integrationsflüssen mit. Du hast Erfahrung mit komplexen Standardlösungen und Integrationslandschaften, idealerweise mit SAP BRIM, S/4HANA oder vergleichbaren Plattformen. Diesen Job melden Would you like to work in a technological company dedicated to the development of medical solutions? Inpeco is the world leader in the automation of clinical laboratories , where we create innovative robotic solutions to manage biological samples. Our systems reduce the possibility of human error, limit the risks of contamination and guarantee complete traceability of the sample. Our solutions support over 2.700 clinical laboratories worldwide . The Inpeco Group has its headquarters in Novazzano (Switzerland) , a production plant in Val della Torre (Torino) , a site dedicated to Innovative Projects in Pula (Sardinia) , a small site in Verona and five reference locations for the foreign market in Belgium, United States, Germany, France and Spain. What are you waiting for? Come join the Inpeco team and innovate with us! Position: As a Design Quality Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, safety, and regulatory compliance of Inpeco's medical device products throughout their entire lifecycle. As part of the Quality team, you will lead Design Quality activities, providing strategic direction and technical guidance to ensure that product development processes meet applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business objectives. Collaborating closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, and other cross-functional stakeholders, you will oversee Design Quality activities for both hardware and software development, ensuring the effective implementation of Design Controls, risk management, verification and validation, and design transfer processes. You will also lead and develop the Design Quality Engineering team, fostering a strong quality culture, promoting continuous improvement, and ensuring that quality is embedded throughout the product development lifecycle. Main Responsibilities Lead and oversee global Design Quality activities throughout the entire product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, international standards, and internal Quality Management System procedures. Drive the implementation and maintenance of Design Controls, ensuring effective management of design inputs, outputs, design reviews, verification, validation, design transfer, and design changes. Act as the Design Quality subject matter expert for hardware and software development, providing technical guidance and supporting the review and approval of design documentation, technical specifications, procedures, test protocols, and reports. Ensure Design Quality oversight of software development activities, including compliance with IEC 62304, software risk management, cybersecurity and AI-related regulatory requirements, and software verification and validation. Oversee product risk management activities throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with ISO 14971, appropriate risk identification and evaluation, implementation of risk control measures, and maintenance of risk management documentation. Ensure alignment between design activities, risk management, verification and validation results, and post-market data to support ongoing product safety and effectiveness. Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Suppliers, and other cross-functional teams to ensure that quality and regulatory requirements are effectively integrated into product development and lifecycle management. Lead, manage, and develop the Design Quality Engineering team, providing technical guidance, coaching, mentoring, and performance management while fostering accountability and a strong quality mindset. Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring the effective management and resolution of Design Quality-related findings. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance Design Quality processes, strengthen regulatory compliance, and support global business objectives. Requirements: Skills And Experience Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. At least 7 years of experience in Quality Engineering within the medical device industry, including at least 4 years of specific experience in Design Quality. At least 1 year of experience in people management, with demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop technical teams. Strong knowledge of applicable medical device regulations and international standards, including ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820, and EU MDR 2017/745 or EU IVDR 2017/746. Proven experience in Design Controls and medical device design and development processes, including design reviews, verification, validation, and design transfer. Solid understanding of hardware and software development processes within the medical device industry. Experience in product risk management throughout the product lifecycle, including risk analysis, risk evaluation, risk control, and risk management documentation. Knowledge of applicable software development standards, particularly IEC 62304, as well as cybersecurity and emerging AI-related regulatory requirements. Experience supporting internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and risk-based approach to decision-making. Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, drive initiatives, and deliver results within established timelines. Proactive, flexible, and adaptable, with the ability to operate effectively in an international and rapidly evolving environment. Fluent in English; Italian is a plus. Nice to Have Previous experience in a global medical device organization and in managing international or cross-functional teams. Experience with both hardware and software medical device development, particularly within complex or integrated systems. Knowledge of cybersecurity requirements and emerging regulatory frameworks for AI-enabled medical devices. Experience with post-market surveillance, complaint handling, and the integration of post-market data into product risk management and design activities. Experience with process improvement methodologies and Quality Management System optimization. Knowledge of project management methodologies and tools. Ability to promote and communicate quality objectives effectively, influence stakeholders, challenge existing practices, and drive continuous improvement. Other information: What We Offer Dynamic work environment where you can make a difference and grow your career International work location in our headquarter in Switzerland (Novazzano) Flexible working hours Working time account: possibility to accrue additional hours of free time in addition to holidays Additional contribution to the pension fund Professional and non-professional accident insurance Company restaurant Incentives for mobility by public transport Agreements for bank account, credit card and personal purchases Opportunity of professional and salary growth through various initiatives: Annual performance appraisal in order to evaluate the achievement of individual objectives Internal job posting to apply for career opportunities in Inpeco, even between different locations Annual salary review linked to performance and professional development Continuous training on the job, through meetings or conferences, seminars and events. Activewear & Accessories Category Specialist Brand: Corporate Location: Milano, IT If you’ve worn a pair of glasses, we’ve already met. We are a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames, and sunglasses. We offer our industry stakeholders in over 150 countries access to a global platform of high-quality vision care products (such as the Essilor brand, with Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest and Transitions), iconic brands that consumers love (such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear and Costa), as well as a network that offers consumers high-quality vision care and best-in-class shopping experiences (such as Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò and the GrandVision network), and leading e-commerce platforms. Join our global community of over 190,000 dedicated employees around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry. Discover more by following us on LinkedIn ! Your #FutureInSight with EssilorLuxottica Are you willing to pioneer new frontiers, foster inclusivity and collaboration, embrace agility, ignite passion, and make a positive impact on the world? Join us in redefining the boundaries of what’s possible. Your role We are looking for an Activewear & Accessories Category Lead who will support the development, coordination and execution of the global Activewear & Accessories product line within the Global Product Department. In this role, you will help identify consumer, retailer and athlete needs by leveraging market research, category analytics, and product insights to support the creation of innovative and commercially successful collections. You will contribute to the definition of seasonal product strategies, collection frameworks and go-to-market activities, ensuring alignment with business objectives and category priorities. Working closely with Design, Product Development, Sourcing, Planning, Marketing, Procurement and Sales teams, you will support the entire product lifecycle, from concept generation through market launch, with the objective of driving growth, profitability and brand consistency across the category. The role will also provide exposure to the management of the global Culture Apparel collection.​ Main responsibilities: Drive global category strategy through market analysis, consumer insights, competitive benchmarking, and trend forecasting. Own assortment performance, ensuring SKU efficiency, profitability, productivity and achievement of business targets. Translate market and sales insights into product direction, delivering innovative and commercially successful collections. Lead the global line plan, including assortment architecture, product positioning, key features and pricing strategy. Partner cross-functionally with Design, Development, Sourcing, Planning, Marketing and Sales to deliver best-in-class products. Ensure seasonal calendar execution, proactively managing milestones and risks to guarantee on-time delivery. Drive product reviews and margin management, balancing innovation, consumer value and profitability objectives. Develop and present merchandising tools, analyses, and seasonal business reviews to support strategic decision-making. Maintain product data integrity and clear communication across all functions throughout the product lifecycle. Lead and influence stakeholders globally, ensuring alignment and consistency across categories, regions and channels. Main requirements: Degree in Marketing, Economics, Business, Product Merchandising, Fashion/Clothing Management or a related field. At least 3.5 years of experience in merchandising, category management, product management or similar roles, preferably within the sports, apparel or accessories industry. Experience in line planning, product assortment management and seasonal collection architecture, with the ability to balance consumer needs, market opportunities and business objectives. Strong understanding of market dynamics, consumer trends and competitive landscapes. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret business and product performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint is required. Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional and international teams. Creative thinker with a consumer-centric mindset and a passion for product innovation. Working knowledge and/or experience in the activewear and accessories market, or a deep, personal interest in the running community and/or active participation in sports and culture is appreciated. Fluent English; additional languages are considered a plus. What’s in it for you In EssilorLuxottica, you are not defined just by your job title. Each career adventure is unique; have a glimpse of some of the benefits you will enjoy as a successful candidate: Access to our cutting-edge learning platform, Leonardo, and personalized development programs to help you grow professionally and personally. Enjoy flexible work conditions, health insurance coverage, ticket restaurants, internal rooftop canteen. Access special offers for employees on a vast range of eyewear, eye care products, and fashion apparel, so you can enjoy our world-class brands firsthand. Enjoy our “Disconnect Program” a holistic approach to work-life balance, including initiatives for mental health, yoga, jogging sessions, and more, designed to help you recharge and stay healthy. Recruiting process Our recruitment process may vary; If you are selected, you will be contacted by our recruiters to guide you through the specific steps for your application.​ Salary Package: Annual Gross Salary: 35.000 Eur – 40.000 Eur Comprehensive Benefits Package: Supplementary Health insurance coverage Supplementary Pension Plan Access to the EssilorLuxottica Corporate Welfare Catalog Transportation – Discounted pass Meal Vouchers as per company guidelines Exclusive employee discounts on company products Company-provided laptop and mobile phone Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitment​ We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and provide equal opportunities to all, regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. Manager - Deal Transformation - Post Merger Integration -  - 10810 - Deloitte Italia Skip to content Deloitte Italia Search jobs Italy Greece Malta Login Current language English - US Manager - Deal Transformation - Post Merger Integration Job Specs Job Name Manager - Deal Transformation - Post Merger Integration Location Milano Business Area STRATEGY & TRANSACTIONS Seniority Manager and above Business Function STRATEGY, RISK & TRANSACTIONS ADVISORY What impact will you make? Manager – Deal Transformation Post Merger Integration Stiamo cercando una figura Manager da inserire nel team Deal Transformation di Deloitte Strategy & Transaction per la sede di Milano , che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid. Il team di Deal Transformation affianca i clienti in ogni fase di una operazione M&A, dalla fase pre-deal con business e operational due diligence a supporto della decisione di investimento, fino alla creazione di valore post-deal tramite integrazione e iniziative di performance improvement. Your role Il Manager in Deloitte ricopre un ruolo strategico: oltre a guidare un team, condividendo il suo know-how e approccio, sarà responsabile della gestione delle relazioni con il cliente e potrà mettere in campo le sue competenze per favorire lo sviluppo del business e mettere in luce le sue qualità imprenditoriali. Nello specifico, sarà responsabile di: M&A Integration & Separation Svolgere attività di separation due diligence/ assessment , analizzando la complessità della separation, la standalone readiness, le implicazioni operative e organizzative, i requisiti di TSA, gli stranded costs e i principali rischi di execution Supportare il design e l’execution di programmi complessi di M&A integration e separation , dalla preparazione alla Day 1 fino alla fase di post-closing, inclusa la gestione degli Integration/Separation Management Offices (IMO/SMO). Supportare il design e l’implementazione delle strategie di integration e separation , degli standalone e target operating models, delle strutture di governance, dei Day 1 e Day 100 plans e delle execution roadmaps. Coordinare i cross-functional workstreams , monitorando interdipendenze, rischi e critical decisions e assicurando la corretta gestione delle criticità secondo gli escalation paths definiti. Value Creation Gestire l’intero processo di synergy assessment , dalla i dentificazione delle opportunità di sinergia alla loro quantificazione , dall’implementation planning al value capture , con l’obiettivo di massimizzare la realizzazione delle sinergie previste dalle operazioni di M&A. Identificare e quantificare one-off costs, dis-synergies, stranded costs e value leakage , definendo azioni di mitigazione e supportando il cost management. Supportare lo sviluppo di business cases e value creation initiatives , valutandone l’impatto economico e operativo. Sviluppare modelli di tracking per monitorare l’avanzamento delle value creation initiatives e la realizzazione del valore rispetto ai business cases e ai target, identificando variances, risks e opportunities. What we offer La retribuzione fissa prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra EUR 50.000 e EUR 54.000 per il grade Manager in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi. La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione. Winning Requirements 6–8 anni di esperienza professionale in management consulting, transaction advisory, business transformation e/o M&A Integration & Separation, Esperienza nella gestione di programmi di Post-Merger Integration, Separation e/o large-scale transformation con una solida conoscenza del M&A lifecycle e delle principali sfide operative e organizzative. Esperienza nella gestione di molteplici f unctional workstreams , coordinando interdipendenze complesse e guidando l’execution di programmi complessi; costituisce un plus l’esperienza su progetti internazionali. Esperienza in q uantitative analysis, business cases, synergy assessments e value creation initiatives , con solide capacità di analisi, problem solving e di tradurre dati e analisi in raccomandazioni concrete. Disponibilità a lavorare in trasferta presso il cliente (anche all’estero); Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata. Make An Impact That Matters Il network Deloitte, leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, opera a livello globale in più di 150 Paesi con oltre 460 mila persone. In Italia, Deloitte è presente in 24 città con circa 13.400 persone che assistono i clienti offrendo servizi di Audit & Assurance, Technology & Transformation, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory e Tax & Legal. In qualità di network globale ci impegniamo per affrontare le principali sfide sociali, economiche e ambientali della società di oggi. WorldImpact è il nostro programma globale che riunisce tutte le iniziative attraverso cui vogliamo avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, i clienti, l’ambiente e le comunità in cui operiamo. Con Impact for Italy, la declinazione italiana di WorldImpact, Deloitte ha realizzato progetti che - in collaborazione con istituzioni, realtà del terzo settore, università e altri soggetti - hanno lasciato un impatto concreto e una legacy per il futuro su tutto il territorio nazionale. CHI SEI Gestisci l’intero ciclo di progettazione della trasformazione dei processi per il tuo settore o funzione: dall’analisi di come le dinamiche di mercato, i cambiamenti normativi e l’evoluzione tecnologica stanno modificando il contesto, fino alla definizione dei processi futuri e delle modalità con cui le persone adotteranno nuovi modi di lavorare. Sei un punto di riferimento per il tuo team nell’ambito di competenza: clienti e colleghi si rivolgono a te per la tua conoscenza approfondita di come funziona concretamente il settore o la funzione. Combini competenze di business, conoscenze tecnologiche e utilizzo dell’AI nei processi per guidare la trasformazione. Ti occupi di AX Design all’intersezione tra persone, agenti AI e processi nell’ambito delle attività di trasformazione. Quando progetti un processo futuro, consideri naturalmente come debba essere strutturata l’esperienza degli agenti AI per supportare sia gli obiettivi di business sia le persone che lavorano insieme a questi agenti. IL TUO RUOLO Integrerai l’AI nella progettazione dei processi futuri dei clienti e nelle modalità di lavoro del tuo team, utilizzando gli strumenti AI più appropriati e creando strategicamente agenti a supporto della realizzazione dei deliverable. In particolare, ti occuperai di: Guidare la definizione dei processi futuri, la progettazione dell’integrazione dell’AI, i cambiamenti del modello operativo e la pianificazione dell’adozione per il settore o l’area funzionale di riferimento. Condurre workshop di discovery con i clienti e interviste agli stakeholder, presentando e sostenendo le raccomandazioni davanti al senior management del cliente e gestendo le relazioni quotidiane e la risoluzione delle problematiche. Guidare analisi di benchmarking e change-impact assessment, facendo leva su una conoscenza approfondita del funzionamento del settore o della funzione. Facilitare sessioni di Design Thinking e workshop di co-creation con team cross-funzionali del cliente. Collegare il modello operativo ai processi futuri, sviluppando approcci alla trasformazione concreti e credibili. Sviluppare e mantenere metodologie documentate di process redesign e contribuire ai playbook relativi alle aree di processo assegnate. Contribuire alle attività di Business Development, qualificando le opportunità e collaborando alla preparazione delle proposte. Supportare e guidare le risorse più junior sulle metodologie di process redesign, sull’analisi dei trend specifici di settore e sulla progettazione dei modelli operativi. FORMAZIONE Laurea triennale o titolo equivalente. REQUISITI ESSENZIALI Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in Process Excellence, Process Redesign o Management Consulting. Esperienza in ambiti vicini al dominio Talent/HR, come HR Reinvention, Change Management, Enterprise Organization o Operating Model. Summary About us Inspiring individuality with innovative craftmanship since 1966. Creativity lies at the heart of all that we do. Born in Vicenza the house is rooted in Italian culture yet maintains a truly global outlook. An inclusive brand with exclusive products Bottega Veneta is as much of a feeling as it is an aesthetic. Job Description Your mission We are currently seeking a Global Digital Media & Insights Manager as part of our WW team in Milan. As part of the wider Marketing & Communication department, and reporting to the WW Director of Integrated Media & Digital Insights, you will lead Bottega Veneta’s Global digital media strategy across Paid Social, Display & Video, and Programmatic, as well as the 360° Media Measurement Center of Excellence , bringing together paid, earned and owned media insights. You will oversee digital media planning, activation and performance (WW excl. China), while driving a data-driven approach to media effectiveness, measurement and optimization. Managing a team of two specialists covering Digital Media and Media Insights, you will work closely with regional teams, internal stakeholders, Kering Media and our Global agency partners (Publicis) to ensure strategic consistency, operational excellence and continuous innovation across the full media funnel. How you will contribute Digital Media Excellence Lead the development and implementation of Paid digital media across paid social, programmatic, display, video, and emerging platforms, ensuring alignment with brand priorities and business objectives. Previous SEA experience considered a plus. Oversee global digital media planning and activation, ensuring consistency across markets while adapting to local consumer behaviors and cultural nuances. Drive full-funnel media effectiveness, balancing brand-building objectives with engagement, traffic and conversion opportunities. Supervise media agency partners to ensure best-in-class campaign execution, optimization, investment efficiency and adherence to brand standards. Identify opportunities to leverage first-party data, advanced audience strategies and platform innovations to enhance media relevance and impact. Monitor the competitive landscape, platform developments and emerging trends to identify opportunities for innovation and strengthen the brand’s digital media positioning. Strong analytical capabilities, with experience using reporting and business intelligence tools such as GA4, Looker, Tableau, Power BI and Excel. Excellent project management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders. Strategic and analytical mindset combined with a hands-on approach, strong attention to detail and a attitude for continuous improvement. Passion and understanding of the luxury industry, with a refined sensitivity to brand positioning, creative excellence and consumer experience. Fluency in English is required. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position To strengthen our Solution Marketing team for the Italian market, we are looking for a proactive and dynamic Product Manager to join our Molecular & Pathology area, with direct ownership of the Serology ID portfolio. In this role, you will take full strategic and operational accountability for your assigned product lines, acting as the critical bridge between global directives and the specific commercial dynamics of the Italian healthcare ecosystem. You will lead the end-to-end product lifecycle—from defining launch strategies and driving adoption to consolidating market share—partnering across multidisciplinary squads to anticipate laboratory needs and deliver meaningful business and patient impact. Serving as the subject-matter authority for our commercial teams, you will provide strategic direction, sales enablement tools, and direct field support in engaging Key Opinion Leaders, clinicians, and hospital laboratories. By pairing strong commercial acumen with a relentless focus on demand forecasting, cost management, and profitability, you will play a central role in executing our annual Solution Network plan and sustaining long-term organizational growth. Key Deliverables & Responsibilities Portfolio & Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end management of the Serology ID portfolio, securing product availability, driving high forecasting accuracy, and orchestrating product launches, updates, and withdrawals Marketing Strategy & Execution: Translate global and regional frameworks into actionable local marketing plans to achieve both quantitative (sales, market share, profitability) and qualitative goals Commercial Enablement: Equip the sales organization with comprehensive product knowledge, training, and promotional assets; join field visits to labs and hospitals alongside commercial partners KOL & Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture enduring partnerships with Key Opinion Leaders, healthcare professionals, and scientific societies to champion serology innovations Market Intelligence & Performance: Track competitor activities and market dynamics, analyzing KPIs to recommend swift corrective measures and shape Solution Network priorities Governance & Compliance: Uphold the highest standards of integrity, ensuring strict adherence to internal policies, healthcare codes of conduct, and IVD regulations Who You Are Education: University degree in Life Sciences (Biotechnology, Biology, Pharmacy, or related fields) or Business Management Experience: 3+ years of commercial or marketing experience within the Healthcare sector, with a strong background in In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) and familiarity with serology or infectious disease diagnostics Key Competencies: Solid business acumen, analytical capability, and a proven track record of meeting quantitative targets Persuasive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical experts and commercial leaders Proactive, organized, and collaborative approach, thriving autonomously and within cross-functional squads Languages: Full professional working proficiency in both English and Italian Compensation & Benefits The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Monza is 43,376.67 - 80,570.00 EUR. CMS At ZOLL, we're passionate about improving patient outcomes and helping save lives. We provide innovative technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Our medical devices, software and related services are used worldwide to diagnose and treat patients suffering from serious cardiopulmonary and respiratory conditions. The LifeVest wearable defibrillator is used by patients at risk of sudden cardiac death (SCA), providing protection as their clinical condition progresses and when the permanent risk of SCA is not defined. The LifeVest allows the physician time to assess long-term risk and choose the most appropriate therapy. The LifeVest is easy to wear and allows the patient to return to their daily activities, while maintaining the security of continuous protection from SCA. In fact, the LifeVest continuously monitors the patient's heart rhythm and, in case of recognition of a life-threatening arrhythmia, the device delivers an electric shock capable of restoring the physiological rhythm. ZOLL Medical Italia is looking for a qualified candidate to manage the territory in south of Italy for the LifeVest division. Job Summary A regional Manager is a vital link between a company's headquarters and locations across a specific region. This role involves overseeing and coordinating regional operations, ensuring each location functions efficiently and effectively. The goal of this position is to oversee the operations and performance of the Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator (LifeVest) as a bridging tool for patients suffering from a high risk of sudden cardiac arrest (SCA). Furthermore, they are responsible for setting goals, implementing strategies, managing team performance, and ensuring the satisfaction of customers. The primary discipline of your work and customer base is in the Cardiology sector, including emergency, resuscitative and intensive care. Lexroom ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Lexroom. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 65.000,00 €/yr - 85.000,00 €/anno Lexroom is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom . We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome. Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product. Why Lexroom ? Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe. Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition. Deliver Meaningful Results: Your contribution will directly influence how legal professionals work—faster, clearer, and more efficiently. At Lexroom , we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world. Role As our customer base expands and our international footprint grows (currently operating across 5+ European markets, including France and Bulgaria), we are looking for a Head of Operations to build, refine, and scale the operational engine powering our Revenue, People, Legal, and Finance teams. Your Key Responsibilities Operating Workflows & Bottleneck Identification: Map, document, and continuously optimize end-to-end workflows across Revenue Ops (Sales, Marketing, CS), People Ops, Legal, and Finance Ops across multiple countries. Operations Roadmap & Prioritization: Own the functional roadmap from start to finish. Implement robust prioritization frameworks to align resource allocation directly with overall company strategy. Cross-Team Tooling & CRM Architecture: Act as the primary architect for our GTM and company tooling stack (HubSpot, Clay, Aircall, Aimfox, etc.). Lead tool selection, integration, and consolidation decisions. AI & Agentic Automation Leadership: Keep Lexroom at the non-engineering AI frontier. Implement internal AI tools, orchestration agents, and automated workflows, evangelizing AI adoption across non-technical teams. Team Leadership & Operational Execution: Manage, mentor, and grow the team of operational specialists and leads. Establish clear working rhythms, 1:1s, parallel project execution, and effective escalation pathways. What We're Looking For 5 to 8 years of experience in Business Operations, RevOps, Sales Ops, or GTM Engineering within high-growth B2B SaaS startups or scale-ups (Series A to pre-IPO). Proven People Management: At least one prior role formally managing, mentoring, or leading a team in an operational environment. Deep Hands-On CRM & Tooling Expertise: Direct, practical experience administering or architecting modern CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive) and GTM automation tools. AI & Automation Mindset: You go beyond using basic AI chatbots—you have designed, implemented, or sponsored automated workflows and AI agents into production operations. Analytical & Problem-Solving Depth: Strong capacity for process mapping, bottleneck identification, and data-backed decision-making. Location & Language: Based in or willing to relocate to Milan (hybrid model with strong office presence). Fluent in English and comfortable working in an Italian-speaking core team environment. Rewarding your contribution Compensation (Milan equivalent): €65,000–85,000 Equity: meaningful equity on top, in line with the seniority of the role Team retreats & off-sites: dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas Benefits That Matter Hybrid Work: Hybrid with strong office presence in Milan HQ Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure peace of mind. Meal Vouchers: Daily support to make your lunch breaks easier. Team Retreats & Off-sites: Dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas. At Lexroom , ambition meets discipline and purpose. We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you. CIFA - Concrete Machinery ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da CIFA - Concrete Machinery. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 45.000,00 €/yr - 60.000,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da CIFA - Concrete Machinery Daniele Di Blasio Daniele Di Blasio CHI SIAMO Dal 1928, CIFA progetta e produce tecnologie per la produzione, il trasporto e il pompaggio del calcestruzzo. Oggi CIFA fa parte del Gruppo Zoomlion , uno dei principali produttori mondiali di macchine per le costruzioni, e ne rappresenta la Business Unit dedicata alle macchine per il calcestruzzo. Forte di una solida competenza ingegneristica applicata al settore delle costruzioni, CIFA sviluppa una gamma progettata per rispondere alle reali esigenze dei cantieri e pone la soddisfazione del cliente come punto di riferimento per ogni soluzione. Con due stabilimenti produttivi in Italia , realizzati secondo i più elevati standard europei, portiamo soluzioni affidabili e competitive a clienti in tutto il mondo, supportate da una rete globale di assistenza e servizi. L'INNOVAZIONE FA PARTE DEL NOSTRO DNA È qualcosa che viene da dentro, l'impulso costante alla ricerca e allo sviluppo per fare sempre di più, e meglio. Perché sappiamo che i nostri prodotti contribuiranno a costruire case, ospedali, scuole e infrastrutture. Luoghi dove le persone crescono, si curano e apprendono. Da quasi un secolo produciamo e investiamo in Italia seguendo il principio base della nostra mission, sviluppare innovazione e applicarla concretamente alle nostre macchine e al nostro metodo di lavoro. Ecco perché, nel corso del tempo, CIFA è diventata sinonimo di alta tecnologia, continua ricerca di soluzioni sostenibili e design italiano pluripremiato. Ma stiamo ancora pensando a come fare di più, e meglio. IL RUOLO Cerchiamo una figura di Area Sales Manager che assuma la responsabilità piena del business sui mercati dell'Europa centrale e porti sul territorio l'intera gamma concrete equipment di CIFA. È un ruolo di governo del mercato prima ancora che di vendita , con la responsabilità del risultato economico dell'area e della relazione con la rete che lo genera. Nel concreto significa: Costruire il budget dell'area Europa centrale e garantirne il raggiungimento; Definire con ogni concessionario obiettivi di volume, di copertura territoriale e di sviluppo, di cui monitorare con continuità l'andamento; Sviluppare la copertura commerciale nei territori aperti a nuove partnership; Presidiare l'intero processo commerciale dalla generazione dell'opportunità fino all'incasso; Leggere il posizionamento competitivo e tradurlo in scelte di prezzo, di mix e di priorità; Utilizzare CRM, pipeline, quote di mercato e marginalità come base delle decisioni commerciali; Rappresentare CIFA presso clienti e partner nei principali appuntamenti di settore dell'area. DOVE SI LAVORA La sede di riferimento è Senago , alle porte di Milano. È qui che si costruisce la relazione con le funzioni tecniche, commerciali e di assistenza e che si acquisisce la conoscenza diretta della gamma. Il ruolo prevede una presenza regolare sui mercati dell'Europa centrale, quindi valutiamo con interesse anche candidature di persone residenti in altre regioni italiane , definendo insieme un equilibrio sostenibile tra presenza in sede e attività sul territorio. GUIDARE LA RETE DI CONCESSIONARI La relazione con i dealer è il cuore della posizione ed è una relazione che va condotta. Chi entra in CIFA definisce con ogni concessionario obiettivi di volume, di copertura territoriale e di sviluppo, ne segue l'andamento con ritmo costante, costruisce insieme il piano di crescita e interviene quando i numeri chiedono un cambio di passo. È la persona di CIFA a portare l'agenda sul tavolo. A questo si affianca lo sviluppo della copertura nei territori in cui vediamo spazio per nuove partnership. DECIDERE CON I DATI Ci aspettiamo un uso quotidiano e naturale del CRM, della pipeline, delle quote di mercato e della marginalità per orientare le scelte commerciali. Per noi è un tratto distintivo del profilo saper argomentare una trattativa con evidenze, riconoscere per tempo un segnale di mercato e difendere il valore dell'offerta con i numeri alla mano. CHI STIAMO CERCANDO Esperienza consolidata nella gestione e nello sviluppo di reti di concessionari; Provenienza da macchinari, construction equipment o beni industriali di valore unitario significativo; Autonomia nella gestione di un territorio internazionale ampio e buona disponibilità alla trasferta; Padronanza degli strumenti di analisi commerciale e uso abituale del CRM; Solide capacità negoziali e approccio proattivo e strutturato; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, preferibilmente accompagnata dal tedesco. CON LA STESSA ATTENZIONE CI PRENDIAMO CURA DELLE NOSTRE PERSONE Offriamo una formazione tecnica a 360 gradi , costruita anche con attività concrete in produzione, perché conoscere davvero la macchina è ciò che rende credibile chi la porta sul mercato. Offriamo opportunità reali di crescita professionale e un lavoro di squadra in cui si entra affiancati dalle colleghe e dai colleghi più esperti, insieme ad attenzione al work life balance e flessibilità . Completano il quadro un piano di welfare pensato per la persona e per la sua famiglia, la mensa aziendale , percorsi di induction strutturati e l'accesso all' Academy interna , lo spazio in cui CIFA sviluppa le competenze tecniche e manageriali delle proprie persone. LA PROPOSTA ECONOMICA Prevediamo una retribuzione annua lorda compresa tra 45.000 e 60.000 euro , commisurata all'esperienza e alle competenze effettivamente maturate dalla persona selezionata, alla quale si aggiunge una componente variabile MBO tra il 20 e il 25% legata al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di area, oltre all' auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo . Inquadramento e condizioni contrattuali vengono definiti nel corso del percorso di selezione, in coerenza con il profilo e con il livello di responsabilità assunto. ENTRA A FAR PARTE DELLA NOSTRA SQUADRA Tu, puoi aiutarci a fare di più, e meglio? Invia la tua candidatura attraverso questo annuncio. Esamineremo con attenzione ogni profilo e ti contatteremo per approfondire insieme il percorso. CIFA è un'azienda certificata per la parità di genere secondo la prassi di riferimento UNI/PdR 125. Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, in cui le opportunità di accesso, di crescita e di valorizzazione sono le stesse per tutte le persone. La ricerca è rivolta a persone di ogni genere, ai sensi dei Decreti Legislativi 198/2006, 215/2003 e 216/2003. Il trattamento dei dati personali avviene nel rispetto del Regolamento UE 2016/679 e della normativa nazionale vigente. La nostra divisione Ricerca e Selezione del Personale cerca un/a EXPORT AREA MANAGER per azienda cliente leader nella progettazione e produzione di macchinari industriali per la lavorazione della carta e della plastica, con sede in provincia nord-ovest di Milano. La figura riporterà al Direttore Commerciale e, attraverso un percorso di formazione tecnica e commerciale sui prodotti, assumerà progressivamente la responsabilità di un territorio internazionale , gestendo in autonomia lo sviluppo del business e delle relazioni con clienti e partner. Si prevede inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato, con un inquadramento al livello Quadro del CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria e un pacchetto complessivo tra 60.000 e 70.000 euro. Benefit: mensa aziendale e auto ad uso promiscuo. Sede di lavoro : provincia nord-ovest di Milano. Non è prevista possibilità di smart working. La persona sarà responsabile della progettazione, gestione e ottimizzazione delle strategie di Lead Generation e Performance Marketing per un portafoglio clienti strutturato. La posizione nasce come figura operativa ad elevato valore strategico (Team Member), con un percorso di crescita definito verso il coordinamento e la gestione del team di riferimento (Team Leader/Responsabile d'Area) al raggiungimento dei KPI di autonomia e performance. Attività e Responsabilità Strategia, Marketing e Lead Generation: Definire, implementare e monitorare piani di marketing e acquisizione per clienti B2B e B2C, coordinando canali, messaging, funnel e campagne di performance marketing in linea con gli obiettivi di business. Growth Marketing & CRM: Sviluppare strategie di crescita lungo tutto il customer journey, integrando acquisizione, conversione, nurturing, retention e sviluppo del cliente. Applicare logiche di Growth Marketing, sperimentazione e CRM per costruire funnel, segmentare i database, automatizzare i flussi di relazione e individuare nuove leve di crescita data-driven. Brand Positioning: Tradurre il posizionamento del brand in strategie, messaggi e iniziative di marketing a risposta diretta, garantendo coerenza tra identità, proposta di valore, comunicazione e percezione sul mercato. Integrazione dell’Intelligenza Artificiale: Adottare strumenti e soluzioni di IA nei flussi di lavoro quotidiani per incrementare velocità, qualità ed efficienza, ampliando le competenze trasversali e liberando tempo per le attività più strategiche. Gestione Cliente e Consulenza: Analizzare esigenze, obiettivi e contesto di business del cliente, trasformando i brief in strategie e piani d'azione; presidiare aspettative, allineamenti e presentazioni di strategie, KPI e deliverable. Gestione Progetti, Risorse e Marginalità: Monitorare l’avanzamento delle commesse controllando tempistiche, qualità, carichi di lavoro e marginalità tramite il software di Project Management aziendale, in sinergia con Project Manager e Specialist. Analisi, Misurazione e Validazione: Valutare le performance delle strategie attraverso dati e metriche reali, identificare margini di ottimizzazione e reportizzare risultati misurabili rispetto ai target concordati. Requisiti e Competenze Esperienza nel ruolo: Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in posizioni analoghe presso agenzie di comunicazione/marketing o come consulente freelance strutturato. Competenze Tecniche: Padronanza delle strategie di Lead Generation, Performance Marketing (Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, ecc.), Brand Positioning e metriche di Growth. Case Study Reali (Requisito indispensabile): Comprovata capacità di presentare casi studio concreti, dati reali e portfolio di campagne gestite con successo. Non verranno valutate candidature prive di casi pratici verificabili. Competenze IA e Strumenti: Utilizzo quotidiano ed efficace dell'Intelligenza Artificiale applicata ai processi operativi, oltre a dimestichezza con CRM (es. HubSpot) e gestionali/ERP (es. Teamwork). Lingue: Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata), indispensabile per la gestione di progetti e interlocutori internazionali. Attitudine e Soft Skills: Spiccata autonomia, problem solving, visione orizzontale e predisposizione al futuro coordinamento di risorse interne. Cosa Offriamo Inquadramento e Retribuzione: Inserimento con RAL commisurata all'esperienza (€40.000 - €50.000) oppure collaborazione continuativa a Partita IVA. Sviluppo Professionale: Piano di onboarding strutturato con potenziale evoluzione nel ruolo di Responsabile di Team previa valutazione reciproca dei risultati. Flessibilità e Autonomia: Ambiente di lavoro basato sulla fiducia, smart working, orario flessibile e focus sugli obiettivi. Innovazione e Formazione: Accesso a piattaforme di formazione (Learn) e affiancamento continuo sulle nuove tecnologie e tool di IA.
