Report this job Company Description Santen is a specialized company with a proud 130-year heritage focused exclusively on eye health. As a Japan-originated, global company with our footprint in over 60 countries and regions, our mission is to provide essential and significant value to patients and society through our products and services created from our expertise in ophthalmology and from the patient’s perspective. Job Description As the Key Account Manager for Santen Italy, you will be responsible for executing a channel strategy for Santen products in Italy. This includes working closely with the Italian Marketing department to identify key opportunities and negotiating deals with pharmacy chains and e-retailers. You will play a key role in driving sales, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring the alignment of pricing strategies. Your efforts will directly contribute to the successful commercialization of Santen’s current and future portfolio. What You Will Do Develop and implement a channel strategy for Santen Italy products, in collaboration with the Marketing department. Scan the Italian market to identify potential key accounts and opportunities for each of the relevant Santen products. Build relationships with pharmacy chains, e-retailers, and wholesalers, ensuring the alignment of offerings with the established Italian pricing strategy. Negotiate deals with key accounts, aiming to secure agreements that support both sales growth and profitability. Manage assigned accounts, including pharmacy chains, e-retailers, and wholesalers, and execute tailored account plans with each. Deliver specific channel sales targets, focusing on maximizing sales and profitability. Collaborate with marketing and other departments to ensure a cohesive and synergistic approach to selling Santen products through these channels. Regularly track and report on progress with accounts and KPIs to line management. Continuously evolve the channel strategy to build capabilities and ensure growth year on year in this important market segment. Qualifications What You Will Bring to the Role: At least 3 years of experience in Sales or Key Account Management, ideally in the pharmaceutical industry. Experience in selling to pharmacy chains, e-retailers, and/or national accounts such as wholesalers. Strong negotiation skills with experience in securing deals and maximizing business growth. Advanced experience in managing both online and offline assortment, pricing, campaign development, implementation, and tracking. Strong understanding of brand positioning, visual identity, and supply chain processes. Ability to build and maintain customer relationships, with a focus on driving online and offline sales. Proven ability to analyze client potential, identify growth opportunities, and develop strategic action plans. Existing relationships with key pharmacy chains across Italy (preferred). A business qualification (preferred) and fluency in Italian; intermediate level of English. What We Offer The salary range for the Key Account Manager position is EUR 45,174 – EUR 62,114 gross/year, depending on experience. Additional Information Grow your career at Santen A career at Santen is an opportunity to make a difference. Through our long-term vision outlined in Santen 2030, we are committed to be a Social Innovator - addressing the social and economic needs of people with visual impairments. We have team members around the world using their diverse talents to unlock new modalities and drive innovations for patient outcomes, education and treatment. At Santen, we believe in empowering all our team members with flexible ways of working and a highly inclusive work environment. The Santen Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building diverse teams and ensuring a safe and inclusive physical and virtual workplace for every one of our team members. All employment decisions are based on business needs, role requirements and individual qualifications regardless of race, color, ethnicity, national origin/ancestry, religion, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity/ expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require any kind of accommodation during our recruitment process, please let the recruiter from our team know. Segnala offerta di lavoro Novastone Capital Advisors (NCA) is a global firm that solves succession challenges faced by Small to Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs). Through our Operator-Led Buyout (OLBO) Program, we provide a structured and scalable solution for business succession, ensuring lasting success for all stakeholders. NCA is looking for motivated, talented, aspirational mid-career professionals with the ambition to partner with NCA to search, acquire and lead a small or medium-sized enterprise as Chief Executive Officer. As an NCA Searcher, you will spearhead an up to 24-month professional search to acquire one small to mid-sized company. Within the scope of our Operator-Led Buyout (OLBO) Program, you will have access to comprehensive support from NCA during the search, as well as an attractive incentive package in the form of base compensation and vested shares in the acquired company that will further enhance and secure your entrepreneurial journey. If you are interested in reviewing other Operator-led Buyout Programs we offer, visit our website here: www.novastone-ca.com. Please note that we do not invest in start-up or scale-up companies. Successful candidates will search, acquire and manage a company in Italy . We strongly recommend attending one of our Q&A sessions to learn more about the opportunity. Registration is mandatory: https://webinar.novastone-ca.com/ OPERATOR RESPONSIBILITIES Establish together with us a search process aiming to generate sufficient deal flow with the ultimate goal of finding a business to acquire in accordance with pre-defined criteria Manage the acquisition process with the support of our experienced Investment Management team Step into the CEO role of the newly acquired business Proactively generate and evaluate strategic growth options and business opportunities, develop long-term business strategy and 100-day plans Grow the business top line via impactful marketing and sales initiatives Review product/service offerings, portfolio strategies, existing brands positioning and identify gaps and implement improvements Manage geographical expansions, when required, preparing and successfully implementing market entrance strategies Manage efficiency and ensure profitable growth MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS 15+ years of professional experience (including at least 5 years in leadership roles with full P&L responsibility) Academic achievement (Executive MBA or MBA degree preferred) Min. 10+ years of proven track record of running and growing businesses or business units in Italy Strong motivation towards entrepreneurship Fluent in English and Italian Deep expertise and/or strategic vision in one or more of the following sectors/industries: Business Services Healthcare Services Niche Manufacturing Software / Tech-Enabled Businesses Distribution & Logistics NICE-TO-HAVE REQUIREMENTS M&A experience Consulting experience from a top consulting firm Experience managing and operating an SME Owner, Founder or co-Founder of a Start-up Experience in global business development, international expansion Recent successful business transformation experience Open mind towards learning, people and even failure SELECTION PROCESS Every application we receive is read and evaluated personally by our team, with no automated or AI-based screening. Selected candidates will have several in-depth interviews, take online assessments, meet different stakeholders while reviewing their investment thesis, and complete and present a business case assignment over several weeks. The selection process also includes informative, non-evaluating steps such as webinars created for candidates to gather more information about the program and meet the NCA team. Final Assessment Center with the jury selection happens in December 2026 . We are an Equal Opportunity program, and all submitted CVs pass through the same application process, regardless of gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, race, political affiliation, marital status, disability, age, parental status, or any other non-merit factor. For more information on the program, our application and selection process please refer to our website www.novastone-ca.com. Per il potenziamento del Product & Marketing Department , siamo alla ricerca di un/una: Product Manager Industrial Business / Category Products Specialist Il Ruolo Scopo del ruolo è definire la strategia e il marketing mix di alcune categorie di macchinari che fanno parte di un portfolio prodotti destinati a diversi canali distributivi e settori di riferimento perlopiù riguardanti il mondo professionale e industriale (BtB e BtC). Operando in coordinamento con il Marketing & Product Director, proprio responsabile, e cooperando con il Sales Management e la Supply Chain, chi assume il ruolo è inoltre chiamato a relazionarsi a livello nazionale ed internazionale per ottimizzare la vendita delle categorie di prodotto assegnate e assicurare l’ottimale livello di stock. Principali attività: analisi quali-quantitative dei mercati di riferimento (concorrenza, prezzi, prodotti); in coordinamento con il Product Management di casa madre individua la gamma di prodotti più efficace per ottimizzarne la vendita nei canali del mercato italiano; sviluppa piani di Marketing annuali/pluriennali per canali e famiglie di prodotto in collaborazione con il Marketing & Product Director in allineamento ai Sales Directors e alla Direzione di Country; prepara e gestisce il lancio di nuovi prodotti, definisce ed implementa il marketing mix dei prodotti assegnati nei canali e target group di riferimento; in coordinamento con le funzioni rilevanti (Sales, Finance e Supply Chain) sviluppa il budget vendite e il forecast mensile dei prodotti assegnati; analizza la profittabilità dei prodotti assegnati; supporta la forza vendita avvalendosi della figura di Trade Marketing per l'execution di promozioni, attività canvass e di comunicazione delle stesse; applica le linee guida di posizionamento prezzi al pubblico e prezzi per i principali canali distributivi/target groups; definisce linee guida espositive e promozionali coordinandosi con il Trade Marketing e altri colleghi di riferimento; analizza in modo mirato il ritorno su investimenti ottenuti relativamente a specifiche attività. I Requisiti laurea in materie economiche / ingegneria / marketing & economics; minimo 6 anni di esperienza in una posizione analoga ricoperta in un'azienda commerciale e distributiva operante nei settori Industrial/Power-Hand Tools or Durable/Consumer Goods; buon inglese scritto e parlato; ottima padronanza di Excel e degli altri principali applicativi di MS Office e Google Suite. Competenze: ottime capacità di analisi, pianificazione e organizzazione unite a padronanza di metodologia strutturata; capacità di gestire relazioni efficaci in organizzazioni a matrice, relazionandosi con colleghi dell’internazionale; sensibilità commerciale / sales business acumen / sales approach; doti interpersonali e di collaborazione, flessibilità e velocità di esecuzione; ottime capacità comunicative, organizzative e di presentazione; velocità di apprendimento e capacità di ascolto; visione strategica, proattività e propositività. Job Title Sales Manager Hospital & Ambulatory Monitoring Job Description Leading the sales growth of our Hospital & Ambulatory Monitoring (H&AM) portfolio across Italy—own customer partnerships, inspire a high-performing team, and translate the IIG business strategy into strong commercial execution. As Sales Manager H&AM, you will be responsible for managing customer partnerships and the H&AM sales team in Italy, driving revenue and market share growth through disciplined sales execution, strengthening customer relationships, and guiding team performance and development in line with the IIG business strategy and portfolio priorities. Your Role Own customer partnerships across Italy: strengthen strategic customer relationships, win new customers, negotiate contracts, and accelerate market share growth while driving sustainable profitability. Execute the sales strategy and AOP: translate business priorities into effective sales execution, contribute to building accurate forecasts, identify market opportunities, and consistently deliver sales targets. Lead and develop the H&AM sales team: foster a growth mindset, drive accountability and performance, and coach the team to strengthen commercial execution. Drive H&AM sales performance: grow sales and margins, strengthen penetration within existing accounts, and capture new business opportunities across the portfolio. Directly manage strategic accounts in Northern Italy and selected national strategic accounts, while overseeing national sales activities and team performance to ensure strong execution and customer engagement. Contribute to shaping the market: bring customer, competitive, and market insights into the business, identify emerging growth spaces, and support the evolution of monitoring solutions and care models. Turn market insights into sales action: translate customer needs, competitive dynamics, market trends, and sales performance into clear sales priorities and commercial plans. Collaborate across functions: work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities and ensure seamless execution of commercial initiatives. Ensure compliance and operational discipline: uphold Philips business processes, quality standards, and business conduct policies, monitor compliance performance, and address issues appropriately. You're The Right Fit If A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field. 10+ years of commercial experience within Healthcare or MedTech, with a strong background in sales and business development and preferably exposure to patient monitoring and clinical informatics solutions, including PDMS and/or EMR. A proven track record of driving sales growth, gaining market share, and consistently delivering sales targets. Strong leadership attitude that builds, coaches, and motivates high‑performing teams. Excellent stakeholder management and customer engagement skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and with senior customer stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to translate market and customer insights into effective sales actions. Fluency in Italian and English. Availability to travel across Italy as required. Compensation & Benefits Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €55.575,00 – €92.625,00 . We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. This role is eligible for a sales incentive, with your rewards linked to your commercial KPI’s. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision. Benefits include flexible/hybrid working, paid time-off, health and wellbeing benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives and learning and development opportunities. How We Work Together We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations. This is a field role. Posizione Cosa ti offriamo : Ambiente stimolante e data driven: lavoriamo cross team e questo ti darà l'opportunità di confrontarti con persone di talento e nuove attività sfidanti Opportunità di carriera: ogni sei mesi avrai la possibilità di ricevere feedback sull’andamento del tuo percorso e la tua crescita sarà commisurata ai risultati raggiunti Formazione continua: avrai a disposizione corsi formativi e di aggiornamento per ampliare le tue conoscenze con esperti del settore Libertà di metterti in gioco: sarai libero di provare, fallire e provare ancora, perché secondo noi mettersi in gioco è il modo migliore per crescere Benefit: Remote working flessibile: sarai libero di scegliere se lavorare da casa o nei nostri uffici, dove potrai incontrare i tuoi colleghi per una riunione o una partita a biliardino Settimana corta: il venerdì pomeriggio è off Iniziative di welfare: piani specifici dedicati ai genitori e al tempo libero Requisiti Chi stiamo cercando: Cerchiamo una figura di Senior Business Analyst per la linea Web e App della Business Unit Gas & Power . Riporterai direttamente al Business Line Manager e guiderai uno o una junior business analyst. Seguirai in autonomia progetti, o parti di progetti, legati all'esperienza web e app con cui le persone scelgono e attivano luce e gas. In questo ruolo non ti occuperai di un solo pezzo del business. Lavorerai ogni giorno con prodotto, design, tech e marketing, gestirai la relazione con i partner commerciali e vedrai da vicino il legame tra i canali digitali e quelli fisici. Imparerai sul campo come funziona davvero un business che unisce digitale e territorio. Lavorerai in un team coeso e affiatato: ci si dà una mano, si festeggiano insieme i risultati e nei momenti di carico nessuno resta da solo. Si lavora a ritmo sostenuto e con tanta autonomia, il confronto è diretto e le idee buone si mettono a terra in fretta, chiunque le proponga. È una linea in piena trasformazione: stiamo ripensando l'esperienza web e app con un impiego di frontiera dell'intelligenza artificiale, per renderla sempre più semplice ed efficace per chi sceglie luce e gas. Avrai un ruolo attivo in questo cambiamento. Cosa farai con noi: Progetti web e app Gestirai in autonomia progetti di dimensione contenuta, o filoni di progetti più ampi, sull'esperienza web e app: dall'analisi del problema alla messa online, fino alla misura dei risultati. Analizzerai i KPI e la user experience dei funnel digitali per individuarne i punti di miglioramento e proporrai soluzioni che aumentino la conversione Contribuirai a impostare test A/B e ne leggerai i risultati insieme ai team di prodotto e marketing. Coordinerai le attività con prodotto, design, tech e marketing, tenendo traccia di avanzamento e scadenze. Relazione commerciale con i partner Gestirai in autonomia la relazione quotidiana con i referenti commerciali dei fornitori energia partner. Seguirai l'andamento della collaborazione con ciascun partner: condividerai risultati e performance, proporrai azioni di miglioramento e nuove iniziative. Contribuirai alla preparazione e alla conduzione delle negoziazioni commerciali. Raccoglierai le esigenze dei partner e le trasformerai in progetti e attività per il team. Strategia e team Supporterai il Business Line Manager nella definizione della strategia e delle priorità della Business Line. Guiderai e farai crescere il Business Analyst del tuo team. Ecco cosa ci piacerebbe avessi : Laurea in Economia, Ingegneria gestionale, Statistica o discipline affini. 1–2 anni di esperienza in ruoli analitici o di business, meglio se su prodotti digitali, e-commerce o funnel di vendita online. Ottima padronanza di Excel e PowerPoint. Capacità di organizzare il lavoro e di far avanzare le attività con interlocutori diversi. Proattività e spirito di iniziativa: vedi un problema, proponi una soluzione e la porti a terra. Curiosità e voglia di imparare, anche su temi lontani dalla tua esperienza. Orientamento al risultato e flessibilità. Buone capacità relazionali e di comunicazione. Attitudine a far crescere le persone più junior. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Costituiscono un plus : conoscenza del mercato luce e gas e conoscenza di Tableau. In base alle caratteristiche richieste e all’esperienza maturata , offriamo un contratto a tempo indeterminato, con RAL complessiva di €33.000 + ticket da 7€ al giorno . Direct message the job poster from Stealth AI Startup Sabrine Ferchichi Sabrine Ferchichi About Us We are an early-stage technology company operating at the intersection of Energy and AI infrastructure , focused on developing a new generation of efficient and scalable computing infrastructure. Our approach combines distributed computing, modular infrastructure and energy efficiency to support the rapidly growing demand for AI and high-performance computing. The company is developing a new model for deploying compute capacity in a flexible and scalable way, with a strong focus on efficiency, sustainability, reliability and responsible infrastructure development . This is an opportunity to join a growing team at an early stage and contribute directly to the development of a new infrastructure platform, working at the intersection of power, data centers and advanced computing . Role Overview We are seeking a Lead Network Engineer to own the network between our Pods: self-contained, outdoor-deployable AI/HPC compute systems meshed into sovereign clusters across dispersed sites. You will own the inter-pod network, the connectivity of the workloads running on our Kubernetes platform, and network automation, and set the overall network architecture, while a dedicated Fabric Engineer owns the high-performance network inside the pod. Our lab already runs an encrypted mesh between sites with cellular and satellite backup: these are current choices, not dogma, and we expect you to challenge them. 🚀 What you'll work on • The end-to-end network architecture: addressing plan, design reviews and technology choices • A resilient, encrypted mesh between sites, with dynamic routing and failover across heterogeneous and sometimes constrained uplinks (cellular, satellite) • Kubernetes networking: how workloads are connected, exposed and isolated inside and across clusters • Segmentation and tenant isolation, together with our Securitu Engineering Lead • Network automation and observability, so every new pod is provisioned and monitored with no manual work • Field deployments, runbooks, and mentoring our Datacenter & HPC Fabric Engineer, who will report to you Our lab already runs an encrypted mesh between sites with cellular and satellite backup. These are current choices, not dogma: we expect you to challenge them. 🎯 Your first year Take the inter-pod network, cluster networking and automation from lab to production, then validate a multi-pod sovereign mesh on real field deployments, ready to scale into series deployment. 🧠 What we're looking for • 6–10 years of hands-on networking in service-provider, cloud/hosting or multi-site/edge environments, including time as technical lead or design authority • A track record of designing and running a production network across many sites, with dynamic routing, VPN overlays and failover • Experience running networking for a production Kubernetes or cloud platform • Network automation as code, at scale • Fluent English ✨ Great if you also have • Deployments at remote or edge sites with poor or intermittent connectivity • Experience at a cloud provider, ISP, or operator building its own infrastructure • Familiarity with WireGuard, BGP, Cilium/eBPF, Talos or NetBox, or strong reasons to propose alternatives • Experience at a hardware or infrastructure startup or scale-up 💼 What we offer • A senior role with real ownership: your design ships in every unit and every cluster we deploy • Report directly to the CTO and lead your own area from day one • Permanent Contract CCNL Commercio • Competitive salary (€70,000–€130,000 based on seniority) + equity • Based in Milan (hybrid), with relocation support. ⏱️ Our hiring process (less than 3 weeks) 1️⃣ Intro call with our Talent Acquisition team 2️⃣ Technical interview with our Director of Software Engineering 3️⃣ On-site case study 4️⃣ Final interview with our CEO 5️⃣ Job offer We keep it fast and transparent, and we'll give you feedback at every step. 👉 Apply here: link Show more Show less Seniority level Mid-Senior level Employment type Full-time Industries Technology, Information and Internet Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Stealth AI Startup by 2x See who you know

Diesen Job melden VF Corporation is looking for an exceptional eCommerce Product Data Specialist to join Vans team based in Stabio, Switzerland, for a 9-month temporary contract - maternity cover . Let’s talk about the role! As Product Data Specialist, you will help lead an exciting transformation of how we build and manage our eCommerce catalogue. Combining deep data skills with the power of AI, you will design smarter, more automated ways to onboard and enrich product assortments across our digital marketplace. Partnering closely with several internal stakeholders, you will turn multiple data sources into rich, accurate and search-optimized product experiences that set a new standard for the way we work. How You'll Make a Difference We expect that you will deliver unbeatable results whilst fulfilling the following aspects of your role (primary accountabilities): Reimagine and automate the onboarding of seasonal assortments, building scalable, data-driven workflows that reduce manual effort and accelerate time-to-site across marketplaces. Build, merge and maintain product datasets from multiple sources (relational databases, InRiver PIM, Excel and master data feeds) to create a single, reliable source of truth for catalogue creation. Leverage AI to automate content production at scale, including generating SEO-optimized product descriptions and enriching product detail pages (PDPs) across digital platforms. Ideate and develop reporting tools and dashboards to monitor data accuracy, catalogue completeness and product publication velocity, turning operational metrics into actionable insight. Own product attributes management and enrichment, ensuring every product carries complete, consistent and high-quality data that powers filtering, search and a rich customer experience. Define and build product categories, structuring assortments in a scalable, logical way that supports both current marketplaces and future B2B and multi-marketplace expansion. Manage menu navigation and product taxonomy, designing and maintaining the classification structures that make products easy to discover and browse across all digital touchpoints. Extend and standardize onboarding processes across other digital platforms, embedding automation and AI at every step. Develop a strong understanding of Vans products, including key features, franchises and consumer relevance, to improve product storytelling, discoverability and the overall shopping experience Skills For Success To succeed as eCommerce Product Data Specialist, you are passionate about data and technology and excited to reinvent how a product catalogue is built and managed. You combine strong analytical and database skills with a hands-on, automation-first mindset, and you enjoy collaborating across teams to turn complex information into simple, scalable solutions. A University bachelor's or master’s degree in Data, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, Economics, or equivalent experience. Strong data and database skills: confident working with large datasets, relational databases and PIM systems (e.g., InRiver), and merging multiple data sources into clean, structured datasets. Hands-on experience using AI/GenAI tools to automate tasks such as SEO-optimized product copywriting, data enrichment and quality checks. 2-4 years’ experience in a data-focused, eCommerce or digital role; exposure to marketplaces, WHS or B2B is a plus. Language skills: Fluent in English. Any other language would be a plus. Advanced Excel and MS Office proficiency; familiarity with data tools such as SQL, Power Query or Python is a strong plus. An automation-first mindset with a passion for simplifying and scaling processes, plus strong communication skills to collaborate across internal and external stakeholders. Analytical, structured and highly detail-oriented, with strong process-building skills. Curious, humble and eager to learn, with the drive to help transform how we manage our catalogue. A genuine curiosity in understanding sport and lifestyle product features, seasonal stories, consumer needs and merchandising priorities. A commercial and customer-focused mindset, with an understanding of how product data, taxonomy, onsite presentation and discoverability support engagement and conversion. Den Jobinserenten von SIDLER SA direkt kontaktieren Sabrina Beatrice Minut Sabrina Beatrice Minut On behalf of our client, an established and dynamic company, we are looking for a motivated and digitally minded FP&A Specialist to join its finance function. This is an exciting opportunity for a finance professional with a solid accounting background and a genuine interest in technology, automation and process optimization. The position offers a broad scope of responsibilities, combining operational accounting activities with financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, treasury and cost controlling. Beyond day-to-day finance operations, the successful candidate will play an active role in improving internal processes, developing reporting tools and contributing to the digital evolution of the finance function. We are looking for an analytical, proactive and curious professional who enjoys working with numbers, systems and people, and is eager to make a tangible contribution to the business. RESPONSABILITIES: Accounting & Financial Reporting: Manage general ledger activities, account reconciliations, monthly and annual closing procedures, financial reporting and audit-related activities. Treasury & Cash Flow Management: Oversee banking activities and payment processes, ensuring effective liquidity management and accurate short- and long-term cash flow forecasting. Budgeting & Cost Controlling: Contribute to budgeting and forecasting activities, monitor financial performance, analyse budget variances and identify cost optimization opportunities. Process Optimization & Digitalization: Identify and implement opportunities to streamline and automate finance processes, enhance reporting tools and improve the quality, accuracy and efficiency of financial data. Business Partnering: Work closely with Sales, Procurement, Operations and other business functions, providing financial analysis and insights to support operational and strategic decision-making. YOUR PROFILE: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Management Engineering or a related discipline. 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in accounting, finance, controlling or a similar position. Solid knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting and core finance processes. Good understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management and cost controlling, or a strong willingness to further develop in these areas. Strong digital aptitude and a genuine interest in financial systems, automation and data-driven reporting. Excellent command of Excel; familiarity with ERP systems, BI tools and reporting automation solutions will be considered an advantage. Ability to interact effectively with different business functions and translate financial information into clear and meaningful insights. Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES: Analytical mindset and strong attention to detail. Proactive, hands-on and solution-oriented approach. Curiosity and enthusiasm for technology, digitalization and continuous improvement. Strong sense of responsibility, accuracy and ownership. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a team environment. This role is ideal for a finance professional looking to broaden their responsibilities and take an active role in shaping the future of a modern finance function. You will have the opportunity to combine strong accounting fundamentals with financial analysis, digital innovation and process improvement, contributing directly to the efficiency, transparency and performance of the business.
